steps.code: <?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';$results=[];$q=NGL_Quiz::questions();foreach([[[1,2,0],100],[[1,2,1],67],[[1,0,1],33],[[0,0,1],0]] as $case){$r=NGL_Quiz::grade($q,$case[0]);if(is_wp_error($r)||$r['score']!==$case[1])throw new Exception('Score test failed');$results[]='Score '.$case[1].' passed';}foreach([null,[],[1],[1,2,0,0],['1',2,0],[99,2,0],[-1,2,0]] as $invalid){if(!is_wp_error(NGL_Quiz::grade($q,$invalid)))throw new Exception('Invalid answer test failed');$results[]='Invalid answers rejected';}$files=array_merge(glob('/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ng-learning/*.php'),glob('/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ng-learning/includes/*.php'));foreach($files as $file)token_get_all(file_get_contents($file),TOKEN_PARSE);$results[]='PHP parse all '.count($files).' files';$course=get_posts(['post_type'=>'ngl_course','numberposts'=>1])[0];$u=get_user_by('login','outsider');wp_set_current_user($u->ID);if(current_user_can('edit_post',$course->ID))throw new Exception('Subscriber CPT edit access');$results[]='Subscriber cannot edit course CPT';wp_set_current_user(1);$page=wp_insert_post(['post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>'LMS shortcode','post_content'=>'[ng_learning_demo]']);file_put_contents('/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ng-learning/unit.json',json_encode(['checks'=>$results,'page'=>$page,'wp'=>get_bloginfo('version'),'php'=>PHP_VERSION]));
